summary: Create or progress a local refurbishment task
description:
Multi-step endpoint driven by the `desire` field, which selects the branch executed by `LocalRefurbishmentController`. A `checkIsTaskCompleted` pre-check runs first; if `taskId` refers to an already-completed task, the request short-circuits with a 200 "Task is completed by <name>" response instead of reaching the controller. After the branch below runs, `mutateTask` creates/updates the underlying task and lead status and returns the final response. Depending on `desire`, the shape of `localRefurbishment` and `payment` differs: - `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_RAISED`: creates a LocalRefurbishment document from
  `localRefurbishment[]` items `{ description, document, amount }` and links
  it to the lead.
- `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_APPROVED` / `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_REJECTED`: updates
  `EachLocalRefurbishmentSchema` items identified by
  `localRefurbishment[].refurbishmentId` using `{ refurbishmentId, status, amount }`.
- `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_PAYMENT_REQUEST_RAISED`: creates a Payment document
  from `payment` and updates approved items with
  `{ refurbishmentId, amount, billDocument }`, plus top-level `paymentTo`
  and `transportationCharge`.
- `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_PAYMENT_REJECTED`: marks `payment.paymentId` rejected. - `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_PAYMENT_CONFIRMED`: marks `payment.paymentId` done
  using `{ paymentId, invoiceUrl, paymentMode, paymentProcessedAt }`.
- `LOCAL_REFURBISHMENT_INSTALLATION`: updates items with
  `{ refurbishmentId, installationUrl }` and marks them `INSTALLED`.

payment.description: Shape varies by `desire`: payment-raise uses paymentMode/totalAmount/bank/accountHolderName/accountNo/ifsc/upiId/accountProofUrl; confirm/reject use paymentId (plus invoiceUrl/paymentMode for confirm).

NOTE — real app quirk: this route is registered on the exact same path ("/update-checklist") and HTTP method (PATCH) as the `updateCheckList` handler documented above `PREFIX.UPDATECHECKLIST`.
